Title: Verify Static Web Table headers and number of rows
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Expected headers: BookName, Author, Subject, Price
Steps: 1. Scroll to 'Static Web Table' 2. Read the column headers 3. Count the data rows
Expected Result: Headers are BookName, Author, Subject, Price; table has 6 data rows

Title: Verify books can be filtered by author in the Static Web Table
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Read all rows of the Static Web Table 2. Filter rows where Author = 'Mukesh' 3. Collect book names
Expected Result: Books 'Learn Java' and 'Master In Selenium' are returned

Title: Verify the total price of all books in the Static Web Table
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Read the Price column of all 6 rows 2. Add the prices

Title: Verify the Chrome CPU value in the Dynamic Web Table matches the value shown below the table
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Locate the 'Chrome' row and the 'CPU (%)' column (column order changes on every load) 2. Read the CPU value from the table 3. Read 'CPU load of Chrome process' text below the table 4. Compare both

Title: Verify the Dynamic Web Table has 4 processes and every value carries the correct unit
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Count the rows of the Dynamic Web Table 2. Read Firefox Memory, System Network, Internet Explorer Disk and Chrome CPU values
Expected Result: 4 rows; values end with MB, Mbps, MB/s and % respectively

Title: Verify Pagination Web Table shows 5 products on each of its 4 pages
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Count the pagination links 2. Click page 1, 2, 3 and 4 one by one 3. On each page count the product rows
Expected Result: There are 4 pages; each page shows 5 rows (20 products in total)

Title: Verify the first row of the Pagination Web Table on page 1
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Stay on page 1 of the Pagination Web Table 2. Read ID, Name and Price of the first row
Expected Result: First row is ID 1, Name 'Smartphone', Price '$10.99'

Title: Verify product checkboxes can be selected on different pages of the Pagination Web Table
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. On page 1 tick the checkbox of 'Laptop' 2. Verify it is ticked 3. Go to page 2 4. Tick all checkboxes on page 2 5. Verify all are ticked
Expected Result: Selected checkboxes are ticked on each page
